motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Background and border feedback; respect reduced motion.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Horizontal navigation with a clear current view.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:24px;padding:0 16px;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#dededb)}.ds-nav button{font:14px "system-ui",Arial,sans-serif;min-height:54px;padding:12px 2px;color:#4c5559;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}.ds-nav button[aria-current=page]{border-bottom-color:var(--primary,#2f3033);color:var(--primary,#2f3033)}.ds-nav button:hover{color:var(--primary,#2f3033)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #292b2e;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Food record
components.description: Food identity and stock on a white work surface.
components.css: .ds-food{font:14px "system-ui",Arial,sans-serif;padding:16px 20px;border:1px solid var(--border,#dededb);border-radius:12px;background:white;color:var(--text,#292b2e)}.ds-food h2{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-food div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.ds-food button{font:inherit;min-height:44px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--control,#c9cac7);border-radius:6px;background:var(--ground,#f6f6f4)}.ds-food button:hover{background:var(--active,#e9e9e6)}.ds-food button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text,#292b2e);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: A practical workspace with blue-grey surfaces, blue-grey navigation and clearly aligned food information.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent navigation and compact stock filters.
Warm neutral work surfaces and restrained state colors.
Consistent labeled actions across records and editors.
